decisions.decision: Prioritize material parsing before structured topic table.
Use only publication and original_web as source enum values.
System may propose classification candidates, but user confirmation is required.
Only core fields block numeric forecast.
Same-name audio status is a boolean or unknown signal.
External heat may include rankings, search, social media, and platform heat in addition to reads, collections, rating, and comments.
Adaptation signals affect rating and risk explanation.
Channel-level point forecasts are required; forecast interval should not be the main output.
Output five-year total, first-year forecast, and year 1-5 split.
Reuse S+/S/A/B/C/D/E as new-product candidate rating.
Do not output direct development recommendation.
Do not output resource investment level.
Display operator comparators alongside system comparators.
Some explicit material fields may be auto-confirmed, but key judgment fields require human confirmation.
M3 local non-formal candidate development may start before M2 formal completion.
Initial test input is a single material file, not a structured topic table.

forecastOutputPolicy.m2FollowUp: Review whether M2 old-product evaluation should also move away from interval-first output.
